title: Trieu Tien Episode 2: The Blade Awakens
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, wuxia/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic who enjoy epic visual storytelling and the warrior's awakening
tone: Heroic, fierce, epic, cinematic, emotionally charged

concept.hook: The sword chose her. But before it would save her — it had to break her first.
concept.story_arc: The sword trembles → Blood awakens the blade → The first spirit memory → Soldiers breach the gate → She draws — and the temple burns
concept.emotion: Anticipation → Pain and awakening → Wonder and connection → Rising tension → Fierce triumph

shots.prompt: Close-up extreme — the ancient sword embedded in the stone altar. It trembles. Dust falls from its blade. A low resonant hum emanates from the metal — an ancient sound not heard in generations. Crimson characters on the blade flicker to faint life, then fade. The phoenix hairpin in her hair glows warm gold in response. She stares at it, breath held. Camera: extreme close-up steady hold on the trembling sword blade, the faint crimson characters glowing and fading, dust motes falling. Very slow push in toward the blade. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Push in — extreme close-up trembling blade, characters glowing, 6s
shots.narration: She had made her vow. And the blade — silent for three hundred years — answered. It trembled as if remembering what it was to be held by one worthy of its hunger.
shots.sfx: Ancient sword hum resonance, stone dust falling, hairpin gold chime, wind through broken temple, heartbeat intensifying

shots.prompt: Medium shot — she kneels before the altar. She reaches out and grips the leather-wrapped hilt with both hands. The moment her skin touches the ancient leather, she gasps — pain lances up her arms. Crimson light erupts from the blade's tip, searing through her palms. Blood — her blood — runs down the hilt and onto the stone. She does not let go. The blade feeds on blood to wake. Flash vision: a warrior in crimson battle robes gripping this same sword, standing over a field of corpses under a blood-red sky. She gasps but holds fast. The sword groans — rising. Camera: medium shot,她的手紧握剑柄，血光从剑尖爆发，手臂颤抖却决不松手。慢慢推近到她的手紧握剑柄特写。6秒。
shots.camera: Push in — gripping sword, blood light, arm shaking, 6s
shots.narration: Three hundred years of silence. And it demanded blood to wake. She gave it freely — her palms split open on the ancient leather, and the blade tasted her oath.
shots.sfx: Ancient blade groaning as it rises, blood sizzle on heated metal, spiritual energy whoosh, gasp of pain, leather grip creaking

shots.prompt: Close-up — the ancient sword pulls free from the stone altar with a thunderous crack. Stone shatters. Dust erupts. The blade is revealed: three feet of dark crimson metal, ancient characters running its length, a faint residual bloodstain that will never wash away. A cold wave of spiritual energy blasts outward from the blade, pushing back the incense smoke and mist. She stares at the sword in her bloodied hands — and sees a flash vision: her father's face, proud and fierce, raising this very sword against an army of ten thousand. She blinks — and the vision fades. Her father. This was his blade. Camera: close-up on the sword as it breaks free from stone, dust and light erupting, then a flash of her father's face in the crimson blade's reflection, then back to her bloodied hands holding it. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up — blade breaking free, flash of father's face, bloodied hands, 6s
shots.narration: It was his. Her father's blade — the weapon the sect had sealed away the day they executed him. She held three hundred years of war in her trembling hands.
shots.sfx: Stone shattering, spiritual energy blast outward, wind rush, vision whoosh, heartbeat thundering

shots.prompt: Wide shot — the army's first wave has reached the outer temple courtyard. Iron-booted soldiers pour through the shattered gates, formation disciplined and terrifying. The first soldier in black armor raises his iron halberd and charges directly at her — screaming a war cry. She stands at the top of the inner sanctum steps, the ancient crimson sword held low in her right hand, blood still dripping from her palms onto the stone. The phoenix hairpin glows bright gold in her hair. The war drums pound louder. Camera: wide shot, soldiers charging up steps, her solitary crimson figure at top with sword held low — the calm before the storm. Slow pan left tracking the charging soldier, then cutting to her face — completely calm, eyes burning gold. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — soldiers charging + cut to her calm burning eyes, 6s
shots.narration: The first soldier charged. A hundred pounds of iron and fury, screaming death at a woman in crimson silk. She did not move. Not yet. The blade was still remembering how to want blood.
shots.sfx: War drums pounding intensely, iron boots thundering on stone steps, soldier war cry, wind howling through broken gates, her breath calm and slow

shots.prompt: Medium close-up — she moves. One fluid motion. The crimson blade arcs upward through the air in a perfect crescent strike. There is no sound of impact — only a flash of crimson light as the ancient sword cleaves through iron armor, halberd shaft, and soldier as one seamless strike. The soldier's body does not fall apart — it simply dissolves into crimson light that races back along the blade and into her arm, absorbed. Her eyes flare gold. Spiritual energy ripples visibly around her body — a faint crimson aura. She lowers the blade. Her face: calm, beautiful, utterly without mercy. Behind her, the ancient sword embedded in the stone altar for three hundred years now rests in her hands — finally free. Camera: medium close-up, the strike arc in slow motion with crimson light flash, then rapid cut to her lowering the blade, gold eyes burning, crimson aura, beautiful and terrifying. End on her calm face. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Slow-mo strike arc + crimson light flash + push in to gold eyes, 6s
shots.narration: One strike. One dissolving soldier. And the ancient blade remembered what it had been made for — not defense. Not ceremony. War. And now — it had found its wielder once more.
shots.sfx: Sword arc through air whoosh, iron and flesh cleaving resonance, crimson energy absorption whoosh, power surge bass rumble, war drums stopping momentarily in shock

audio.narration: She had made her vow. And the blade — silent for three hundred years — answered. It trembled as if remembering what it was to be held by one worthy of its hunger. Three hundred years of silence. And it demanded blood to wake. She gave it freely — her palms split open on the ancient leather, and the blade tasted her oath. It was his. Her father's blade — the weapon the sect had sealed away the day they executed him. She held three hundred years of war in her trembling hands. The first soldier charged. A hundred pounds of iron and fury, screaming death at a woman in crimson silk. She did not move. Not yet. The blade was still remembering how to want blood. One strike. One dissolving soldier. And the ancient blade remembered what it had been made for — not defense. Not ceremony. War. And now — it had found its wielder once more.

visual_scene: An ancient Taoist temple at dawn, dust and incense smoke swirling. A stone altar at the temple's inner sanctum. An ancient three-foot dark crimson sword embedded in cracked stone, crimson characters glowing faintly on the blade. A young woman in flowing crimson Hanfu with gold embroidery kneeling then standing at the altar, bloodied palms gripping the ancient blade. Flash visions of a warrior father in crimson robes on a battlefield. Soldiers in black iron armor charging up stone steps, war drums pounding. A single arc strike with crimson light flash, a dissolving soldier absorbed as crimson energy into the blade and arm. Her eyes burning gold with a crimson aura rippling around her body. Cinematic portrait 9:16 vertical framing. Heroic, fierce, epic atmosphere.
